Personal Mini Air Drone. A delivery drone linked to your Neuroport (10m), 12 hours a charge (1 hour to recharge). A magclamp carries up to 7kg of anything metal; chip slot, radio, LL/IR/UV camera. Standby: idle. Transport: flies a package to an address (or waits for a Neuroport to confirm) and comes home; can't fight or dodge. Direct Control: you fly it from your Neuroport as if you held its Control Node; it can't dodge bullets. Teaching: projects whatever's on a Memory Chip for everyone around.

Cost: 2,000eb (V. Expensive)
MOVE: 4
HP: 10
Counter: DV13 E/S Tech, 1 min to counter
